as of unknown time (age unknown) - Paul Brenton (Points Over Hype) weekly ranks - ranking check only, no points; no timestamp - treat as missing

Jeff Ratcliffe (FTN) projects about 2.7 field goals a game for top kickers, so his kicker numbers run 11-14 points against Yahoo's 7-8. Scored correctly in each league's rules; it lifts both sides of a matchup about equally, but a kicker-vs-kicker call should lean on Yahoo too.
